using Base64
const B64 = ""
const SPECS = ["0:0", "1:0", "2:0", "4:0", "0:1", "1:1", "2:1", "4:1"]
const TMO = 900
function esc(s)
    io = IOBuffer(); write(io, '"')
    for c in String(s)
        c == '"' ? write(io, "\\\"") : c == '\\' ? write(io, "\\\\") : c == '\n' ? write(io, "\\n") : c == '\t' ? write(io, "\\t") : (c < ' ' ? write(io, ' ') : write(io, c))
    end
    write(io, '"'); return String(take!(io))
end
function main()
    dir = mktempdir(); gz = joinpath(dir, "s.jl.gz"); f = joinpath(dir, "s.jl")
    write(gz, base64decode(B64)); run(pipeline(`gunzip -c $gz`, stdout = f))
    runs = String[]
    for sp in SPECS
        var, prof = split(sp, ":")
        so = joinpath(dir, "out.txt"); se = joinpath(dir, "err.txt"); t0 = time()
        cmd = addenv(`timeout $TMO $(Base.julia_cmd()) --project=$(Base.active_project()) $f`, "VAR" => var, "PROFILE" => prof)
        proc = run(pipeline(ignorestatus(cmd); stdout = so, stderr = se))
        lines = filter(!isempty, split(read(so, String), "\n")); last = isempty(lines) ? "" : String(lines[end])
        err = read(se, String)
        push!(runs, "{\"spec\":" * esc(sp) * ",\"exit\":" * string(proc.exitcode) * ",\"seconds\":" * string(round(time() - t0; digits = 1)) *
              ",\"result\":" * (startswith(last, "{") ? last : "null") * ",\"stderr_tail\":" * esc(err[max(1, end - 1200):end]) * "}")
    end
    println("{\"host\":" * esc(gethostname()) * ",\"runs\":[" * join(runs, ",") * "]}")
end
main()
